scope: Read-only differential analysis; no expected output or dataset modification

specification_audit.recurrence_threshold: POLICY CHOICE; specification only says history must support recurrence
specification_audit.recurrence_gap_tolerance: POLICY CHOICE; no numeric tolerance specified
specification_audit.variable_amount_mean: UNSUPPORTED ASSUMPTION; neither specification nor solved examples mandates Decimal mean
specification_audit.month_end: POLICY CHOICE; no month-end rule specified
specification_audit.scheduled_credits: SPECIFICATION-EXPLICIT for confirmed salary; generic scheduled credit is POLICY CHOICE/ambiguous
specification_audit.failed_obligations: SPECIFICATION-EXPLICIT exclusion of failed/cancelled rows; replacement timing is POLICY CHOICE/ambiguous
specification_audit.terminal_payroll: EXAMPLE-SUPPORTED lifecycle evidence; not a universal textual rule

counterfactuals.current: Forecasts repeated variable categories at arithmetic mean and includes them in earliest-date forecasts; safe amount excludes some non-protected variable categories.
counterfactuals.alternative: Forecast only explicit recurring obligations and confirmed future payments; do not infer a Decimal mean for variable spending.
counterfactuals.confidence: high that the mean is unsupported; medium that removing it is the correct hidden-test rule

counterfactuals.current: Recurrence extrapolates historical salary unless terminal description suppresses it; messages may add typed salary credits.
counterfactuals.alternative: Count only explicit settled/scheduled salary or message-confirmed future salary; never extrapolate salary from history alone.

counterfactuals.current: Scheduled salary is included; generic scheduled credits are excluded, while report labels any scheduled context.
counterfactuals.alternative: Include only explicit confirmed future credits; treat all other scheduled credits as excluded.
counterfactuals.confidence: high for salary rule; medium for non-salary

counterfactuals.current: Pending debits are reserved at settlement date; pending credits excluded.
counterfactuals.alternative: Reserve pending debit at the supplied settlement date and do not use pending credits; if event date is the only reliable date, use explicit conservative policy.
counterfactuals.confidence: medium; expected arithmetic requires event-level comparison

counterfactuals.current: Safe amount excludes flexible non-protected and non-protected variable categories, but earliest forecast includes optional categories.
counterfactuals.alternative: Apply one explicit contract: safe amount protects only protected expenses; earliest/full-plan feasibility includes every required recurring debit unless a validated permitted change removes it.
counterfactuals.confidence: high that current two-mode semantics need proof; medium on expected interpretation

counterfactuals.current: Wait fallback requires deadline and full-payment preference.
counterfactuals.alternative: Report capacity date independently; use affordable_later only when capacity exists even if late, or use not_affordable conservatively.
counterfactuals.confidence: high that source is ambiguous; sample evidence mixed

counterfactuals.current: Latest obligation identity, stop/reduce alternatives, minimal action cardinality break.
counterfactuals.alternative: Enumerate every valid event action set up to three, then rank with a documented action-set tie-break.

counterfactuals.current: Credits before debits, then plan payment.
counterfactuals.alternative: Require pre-credit balance for same-day payment unless settlement semantics explicitly establish spendability.
counterfactuals.affected_examples: requires event-date audit; no sample proves order

counterfactuals.current: Category grouping, three observations, lower median gap, 3-day tolerance.
counterfactuals.alternative: Description/source recurrence for fixed obligations; allow explicit message-confirmed cadence; do not use numeric mean as authority.

counterfactuals.current: Deterministic Decimal formatting and generic explanation template.
counterfactuals.alternative: Preserve source precision and render validated fact-bundle explanation.
